storage: Store in a cool, dark, ventilated place, away from onions, for a few weeks. Boiled potato keeps 2 to 3 days in the fridge in a closed box.
looksLike: Oval to round tuber with thin light-brown skin and pale cream flesh. Red-skinned potatoes (kempu aloo gadde) are a separate, pricier variety.
howToPick: Firm, smooth, dry skin with no green patches, sprouts, cuts or soft spots. Avoid any with a green tinge or bitter smell.
shelfLife: A few weeks in a cool dark place (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 40 g per serving, boiled (about ½ small potato, diced)
